title: Web Playlist Management UI Mutations
problem: The web playlist page can read current-user playlists, but it cannot manage playlist mutations through the Public Client contract yet.
gates: npm --prefix web run test -- src/test/data-source-contracts.test.ts src/test/use-media-contracts.test.tsx
npm --prefix web run test -- src/test/route-contracts.test.tsx src/test/route-state-contracts.test.tsx
evidence: WPMU-010 opened the lane from the closed User Playlist contract/web slice follow-on and froze Public Client-only playlist management mutation scope.
WPMU-020 added Public Client-backed web playlist mutation data-source methods and TanStack Query mutation hooks with cache invalidation and fixture non-persistence semantics.
WPMU-030 added /media/my-list playlist create, rename, and delete controls with route-safe mutation behavior and desktop/mobile screenshot evidence.
WPMU-040 added playlist item add/remove UI flows through Public Client mutation hooks, with route/data-source tests and browser smoke evidence.

continue_policy.notes: Continue with WPMU-050. Add accessible playlist item reorder controls through the existing Public Client playlist mutation hooks.
